newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Dampier-Bunbury gas pipeline to be privatised.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Dampier-Bunbury gas pipeline to be privatised.

text.p: The Western Australian government will fully privatise the 1,540 kilometre Dampier-to-Bunbury natural gas pipeline (DBNGP), state energy minister Colin Barnett said on Thursday.
The pipeline is currently owned by the state government and carries a book value of more than A$1 billion.

Barnett told an industry luncheon the government will retain ownership of the pipeline easement and expand it from 30 metres to 100 metres to allow a new owner the option to expand capacity and allow for additional pipelines.
The target for copmpletion of the sale is the end of 1997, Barnett said.
"There will not be any shortage of parties interested in putting forward firm bids for the pipeline," Barnett predicted.
The pipeline transports gas from the North West Shelf to residential and business consumers in the southwest corner of Western Australia
Current capacity is 500 terajoules a day.
